description: This file is a Swift extension for the CritterStatusLabel SwiftUI view, adding private properties, visual behavior methods, and state management functions related to the critter's status indicator in a macOS application.

classes.name: CritterStatusLabel
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that visually represents the status of a critter, including animations for blinking, wiggling, and other motions, as well as state indicators like sleep, pause, and gateway status.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Updates the critter's animation state based on the current time, triggering blinking, wiggling, and movement animations.

methods.name: resetMotion
methods.description: Resets motion-related properties to their default static states.

methods.name: blink
methods.description: Animates the blinking motion of the critter's icon.

methods.name: wiggle
methods.description: Triggers a wiggle animation for the critter's icon.

methods.name: wiggleLegs
methods.description: Animates the legs to make the critter appear to wiggle or scurry.

methods.name: scurry
methods.description: Simulates the critter moving quickly with animated leg wiggle and offset.

methods.name: wiggleEars
methods.description: Animates the ears of the critter to wiggle.

methods.name: scheduleRandomTimers
methods.description: Sets up timers for blinking and wiggling at random intervals.
